From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@bluecrest.io>
To: sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@bluecrest.io
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding: request for PO tokens & spend-buckets

Hi Sergio,

Thanks again for the quick walkthrough earlier. We're ready to move from the trial to paid onboarding and need the following to get finance to raise the PO on our side:

- A purchase reference / PO token we can include in our invoice (one per environment: prod + staging).
- Confirmation of spend caps per token (monthly USD ceilings).
- The canonical line-item SKU mapping for the first invoice (we attached our initial CSV).

I've attached the completed onboarding_form_bluecrest.pdf and the line_items.csv we started with. We made one small change to line 4 after pricing changes; we'll follow up if that needs resubmission.

Could you confirm when you can issue provisional PO tokens and the exact spend buckets so procurement can move forward?

Appreciate it — aim is to go-live the week of Sep 7.

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Procurement
BlueCrest Analytics

Attachments: onboarding_form_bluecrest.pdf (application/pdf), bluecrest_line_items.csv (text/csv)

From: sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@bluecrest.io>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding: request for PO tokens & spend-buckets

Liam — thanks for sending these over and for the clear checklist. Looping in Monica (procurement ops) and Priyom (vendor onboarding) to finalize the PO tokens and confirm spend caps. Quick answers while they review:

- We can provision two provisional PO tokens (one for production, one for staging) that map to distinct spend buckets.
- Default monthly spend cap for a production token is $25,000 unless you request a higher committed cap (we can escalate). Staging tokens default to $2,000.
- The line items look mostly fine, but we flagged an SKU mismatch on your row 4; Monica will provide the corrected SKU mapping and the process to resubmit a corrected CSV so your AP system can accept the PO.

Next steps:
1) Monica will send the resubmission template and confirm the final spend buckets.
2) Once BlueCrest confirms the corrected CSV, procurement will issue the provisional PO tokens and attach a PO PDF for your records.
3) We'll include a DocuSign link for any contract addendum if you elect to raise the production spend cap.

Targeting to have provisional tokens out by Monday 8/31 EOD.

—Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

- PO-45321 (PROD) — spend bucket: $25,000/month — token: PROD-BC-45321-TKN (attached in provisional_po_token.txt)
- PO-45322 (STAGING) — spend bucket: $2,000/month — token: STG-BC-45322-TKN

- SKU-BL-112A now maps to Redwood catalog SKU: RDC-0112-A — we updated the ledger.
- Consolidated SKU for rows 9/10 is RDC-0205 (qty aggregated).
- Please confirm the invoice matches PO-45321 and references token PROD-BC-45321-TKN in the invoice header. That prevents automated rejects on our side.

Attachments included: provisional_po_token.txt (plain text, contains token strings), PO-45321_confirmation.pdf (purchase order PDF).

If you'd like to increase the PROD monthly cap, I can start the internal approval flow — that will create a DocuSign addendum (link below). Otherwise you're good to proceed to billing with the PO and tokens we issued.

DocuSign (increase cap): https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/ABC-BlueCrest-PO
